articles.title: Chilled New York City
articles.summary: Ice in the Hudson River hugged the shore of Manhattan amid a deep freeze.

articles.title: NASA examining hydrogen leaks during Artemis 2 fueling test
articles.summary:
NASA officials defended their preparations for the Artemis 2 mission after a fueling test experienced the same type of hydrogen leaks that bedeviled Artemis 1 more than three years ago.

articles.title: Artemis II Delayed to March
articles.summary: NASA’s Artemis II mission will launch no earlier than March due to several issues that were encountered during a launch rehearsal last night.
